visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fit young woman with a dark ponytail, wearing a white long-sleeved crop top and black high-waisted leggings, stands in a brightly lit white studio. She raises her arms to adjust her hair, highlighting her athletic posture against the clean, shadowless background. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of celebrity endorsements, featuring certificates and signed photos. Then, the woman is seen in various fitness outfits, including a black sports bra and a casual outdoor street-style crop top with a cap and baggy denim jeans. (3) In a minimalist indoor setting with a white wall and a poster, a woman in a pink tank top gestures towards her shoulders and hips while talking. Standing beside her is a woman in a professional dark blue medical-style uniform with her hands politely folded. (4) Close-up shots demonstrate corrective exercises; the woman in athletic wear performs leg stretches and arm rotations. Detailed yellow and white text overlays provide instructional steps for correcting posture, while the camera remains static at an eye-level angle. (5) A split-screen montage displays four different home and studio environments simultaneously, showing women practicing the body management routines. The lighting ranges from warm indoor tones to bright natural light from nearby windows in the living room settings. (6) The video ends with high-quality promotional graphics showcasing the course title and professional portraits of the instructor. The narrator then appears in a final close-up, smiling and using a pen to point at a discount code on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM kicks in with a clear 4/4 drum beat. A female narrator speaks with a high-arousal, cheerful tone, introducing the fitness concept. The vocal quality is pristine, typical of a studio setting. (2) As visual transitions occur, a quick 'whoosh' sound effect bridges the segments. The narrator maintains a fast speech rate while discussing common body issues. The music remains a consistent, upbeat backdrop without masking the speech. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the first instructional tip on screen. The narrator's pitch becomes slightly more instructional and focused. No ambient or background noise is detectable, ensuring high clarity. (4) The BGM continues with synthesized textures and a rhythmic bassline. The narrator explains the 14-day course details, exhibiting high confidence and a positive valence. Another 'whoosh' marks the shift to the split-screen exercise montage. (5) In the final phase, the audio concludes with the narrator presenting a discount code. The voice is enunciated and enthusiastic. The music fades out smoothly following the final call to action, maintaining professional production standards.
